race.description: Scott Ellis Memorial/Ranbuild Warwick Newmarket Hcp (Bm70)
race.comment: DUOMO (8) goes on top after a sound first-up sixth at Eagle Farm, where he began awkwardly, raced keenly through the middle stages and still picked up well in the straight. Is sure to have come on from that and gets significant weight relief with the 3kg claimer taking over. Bold showing anticipated. CERTIFIED COPY (5) is the main danger after consecutive narrow placings as favourite. Shoulders a fitness edge and is draws the A1. BREEZIN' (11) is better than the last-start margin suggests after racing wide throughout at Eagle Farm, and her proven record at this track and trip keeps her right in the winning mix. TREPORTI (2) resumes and has run well without winning fresh. Has peaks that measure right up, so worth keeping in mind.
